prompt: Same cold fluorescent light, fine grain and documentary realism as the first image. The view through a small barred basement window set at pavement level, looking up and out from inside the council archive: the grimy glass frames a night-time high-street pavement at eye level with the ground. Across the pavement, in the doorways of closed shops, people sleep rough in sleeping bags on flattened cardboard, a rucksack, a paper cup, a dog curled against one of them; quiet, still, shown with dignity, faces turned away or covered by hoods. Wet paving, sodium streetlight, a shuttered shopfront. The window frame and its bars are dark in the foreground, the edge of a steel archive shelf just visible at one side. Low camera, ultra-wide, deep focus. Tall portrait frame.
